name: PASS ME NOT
source: Open Hymnal Project ABC score (The Coronation, 1872) consulted.
reviewNotes: No melody yet: add it from a hymn book you trust (see docs/BLOG.md, "Adding a hymn"), then set the hymn's draft to false. Why it is not encoded: the tune is full of dotted-quaver and semiquaver pairs, which the half-beat solfa grid cannot show.
